title: Convolution of a locally integrable kernel with a C_c^∞ function: smoothness and D(K⋆a)v = K⋆(Da·v) (Step 3)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let K : ℝⁿ → ℝ be locally integrable for Lebesgue measure on ℝⁿ = Eucl n, and let a : ℝⁿ → ℝ be C^∞ with compact support. Put ψ(y) := ∫ K(t)·a(y − t) dt. Then ψ is C^∞. Moreover, for all y, v ∈ ℝⁿ the function t ↦ K(t)·Da(y − t)v is integrable and Dψ(y)v = ∫ K(t)·Da(y − t)v dt.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K a : Eucl n → ℝ), LocallyIntegrable K → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y => ∫ t, K t * a (y - t)) ∧ ∀ y v : Eucl n, Integrable (fun t => K t * fderiv ℝ a (y - t) v) ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∫ t, K t * a (y - t)) y v = ∫ t, K t * fderiv ℝ a (y - t) v
